_comment: 相談の 練習の「話しかける タイミング」（要望 #723）。nyam の 席の 絵 4枚: 大丈夫そう（しごとは して いる）・電話中・いそがしそう（あせって いる）・ほかの 人と 話して いる。1枚目（大丈夫そう）が 絵柄アンカーに なり、残り 3枚は 机・小物・構図を そろえて 動きと 表情だけ 変える。looks は 立ち絵の 台帳から 逐語。背景ごと 撮る（切りぬかない）。
style: Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, warm daylight, contemporary Japan, kid-safe e-learning illustration. EMOTIONS ARE BIG AND OBVIOUS, like a Japanese comedy manga.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image: computer screens show only abstract coloured blocks and lines, papers and sticky notes are blank. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: realistic photo rendering, harsh gradients, six fingers, extra limbs, readable letters, dark horror tone, angry faces, real sadness or tears, costume changes between the four pictures, a drawn checkerboard pattern, a second copy of the main character.

scenes.title: 大丈夫そう（しごとは して いる）
scenes.scene:
Character: 先輩の ベテラン エンジニア（ベトナム出身。支払い・通知など しくみの 中を 見る 人。学習者より 先に 日本の 現場に 入った 人） — Vietnamese man in his twenties — draw the face closely after the reference photo, and clearly Southeast Asian rather than Japanese, so the cast reads as international. Warm light-brown skin, a shade or two deeper than the Japanese characters beside him. Wide face with high broad cheekbones, a full squarish jaw and a rounded chin — NOT a narrow pointed anime chin. Broad nose with a low flat bridge, a rounded wide tip and visible nostril wings. Almond eyes set a little wide apart, low single-fold eyelids, outer corners angled gently down. Thick straight black eyebrows. Full lips and a wide easy smile showing the upper teeth. Short black hair, tapered close at the sides and left longer on top so it sweeps up and back off a clear forehead, no fringe. Wears a coral (#F2654A) knit cardigan over a plain cream button-down shirt with the collar open, dark navy ankle-length trousers, and beige low-top sneakers. Carries a small A6 white notebook and a blue ballpoint pen. Height about 170cm, slim build, relaxed upright posture.
Setting: the bright small software team office in Japan from the office reference picture (morning light from the windows on the left, whiteboard, potted plants). He sits on an office chair at his own desk. On the desk: a laptop and one external monitor, his small white A6 notebook and a blue ballpoint pen, a coffee mug. Camera: eye level, from slightly front-left, a medium shot showing him from the waist up and the whole desk top; he is in the centre of the picture with some office visible around him. This first picture sets the desk, props and framing for the next three pictures.
State: calmly working — it would be fine to talk to him now. He types on the laptop at an easy pace, shoulders relaxed, sitting upright, a calm focused face with a small gentle smile, looking at the screen. The desk is tidy. He is clearly working, but not in a hurry. The expression and body language must read clearly at a glance even when the picture is small.
